items.title: Shadowfax clocks Rs 1,538 cr revenue in Q2, profit rises 5x

items.title: Startup news and updates: daily roundup (October 30, 2026)
items.summary: YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here’s the roundup for Friday, October 30, 2026.

items.title: Waiting for an AI law is a poor compliance strategy
items.summary: India's courts and sectoral regulators have already begun assigning liability for AI failures. Businesses that are holding out for a statute are preparing for the wrong deadline.

items.title: Govt notifies National Social Security Board for gig, platform workers
items.summary: The Board is mandated to design, monitor, and recommend targeted welfare schemes to bridge the social security gap for millions of gig and platform workers, alongside traditional unorganised workers.

items.title: TRAI September 2026 data: India adds 6.47M broadband connections to reach 1.108B
items.summary: India's broadband connections reached 1.108 billion in September 2026, up 0.59% from August. Jio and Airtel dominated the market, while 5G fixed wireless access subscriptions continued to grow. The post TRAI September…

items.summary: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinical psychologists, they can represent something more sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders. A new…

items.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
items.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots…

items.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
items.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

items.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
items.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

items.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.summary: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

items.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
items.summary: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

items.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
items.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
